extension.summary: The time and date as maths puzzles, typeset like LaTeX
extension.description: A clock you solve: the hours, minutes, seconds and date are each shown as a random equation whose answer is the current value, such as √144, h + 7 = 19 or 84 ÷ 7, typeset in Computer Modern like LaTeX. Based on themathclock.com, with its settings: seconds, 24-hour clock, date, labels, inverted colours and day/night mode. Adds fractions, powers, logarithms, sums and binomials, fades between equations and a slow drift to protect OLED screens.
extension.disclaimer: Glyphs rendered from the BaKoMa Computer Modern fonts (as shipped with matplotlib).
